widgets_values:
[verse]
City of lights you keep my dream alive
City of lights you keep my dreams
I sleep in the day coz I am tired of the fight
But in the night you set a different scene

[verse]
City lights come alive at night
Pretty sights, so many I’ve seen
Pure delight, for sale to those who wish to buy
But on your streets I’ve seen the broken dreams

[verse]
The sound of your song keeps me moving on
Who knows how far, or how long
Stay as long as you make me welcome
Wake up one day and you’ll find me gone

[chorus]
City of light... your mine
City of lights... for me
City of lights... fly
City of lights... my dream

[outro]

# MarkDKBerry.com

YUE-2 Links

basics on comfyui of what you can do with it [https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/audio/yue2/yue2](https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/audio/yue2/yue2)

## EXAMPLE PROMPTS & SETTINGS FOR COVERS:

taken from u/LilBrownBebeShoes on reddit recommendations:

1. `English, energetic and polished male baritone vocal with a pop-rock edge, early 2000s pop-punk power-pop, crunchy distorted rhythm guitars, vibrant lead guitar hooks, punchy acoustic drums, prominent melodic bass lines, infectious and anthemic rock atmosphere`
	- ABC Mode Full, Generate Mode Full, Generate CFG 1.2, temp 0.80, top_p 0.95, top_k 100, rep_penalty 1.20, Sampler CFG 1, Steps 64, DPM_2, sgm_uniform
</br>

2. `English, breathy, cinematic female vocal with a vintage, melancholic tone, orchestral dream-pop and slow-burn noir ballad, lush string section, reverb-drenched electric guitar, warm vinyl crackle, subtle slow-tempo percussion, haunting and nostalgic atmosphere`	
	- ABC Mode Full, Generate Mode Full,Generate CFG 2.0, temp 0.90,top_p 0.95,top_k 100,rep_penalty 1.20,Sampler CFG 1,Steps 64,DPM_2,sgm_uniform
</br>

3. `English, gritty and emotionally charged male vocal with raw rock texture, mid-2000s post-grunge electro-exotic rock fusion, fast-paced 135 BPM driving groove, wall-of-sound distorted electric guitars and massive layered choruses, pulsing synth bass, middle-eastern inspired electric sitar motifs, energetic electronic percussion layered with heavy acoustic drums, dramatic and aggressive high-energy atmosphere`
</br>

4. `English, intimate and emotionally rich female vocal, dramatic piano ballad, warm grand piano, subtle ambient synth textures, delicate cello, cinematic orchestral strings, gentle acoustic percussion, melancholic and deeply expressive atmosphere`
